offers.sn: Join Bally’s Intralot as a Network Engineer (Enterprise IT) To meet our current corporate needs, we would like to bring to our team a Network Engineer. In your new role, you will undertake tasks, such as: Network Monitoring
offers.rq: University or College Degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Systems or relevant technology-related field So, you need to have at least 3 years of experience in Network Engineering You hold a CCNA level certification and you are experienced (CCNP preferred) You are fluent in English language (both oral and written skills)
